answer: The elder walks each terrace wall after the rains and counts the stones the repair gang has reset, signing the gang off only when the count matches. A plume wall claimed as repaired fails the count: at the copper of the stones the wall must hold the gang's own work, and a wall no gang touched shows loose stones at once. Forging a season of repairs means hiring a gang, resetting two thousand stones and paying 17,500, and the violet book in the elder's house is read at every harvest, so a wall whose stones were never counted is rebuilt by the village.
